prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 anime-style portrait illustration of a charismatic young male scholar in a warm, old-world study. The subject is a slim, handsome young man with deep auburn red wavy medium-length hair, long bangs falling over one eye, sharp emerald green eyes, fair skin, and a subtle confident smile. He stands in a three-quarter pose, looking directly at the viewer, with one hand raised thoughtfully to his lips and the other arm folded across his torso while holding a closed dark book. Dress him in a crisp cream dress shirt with slightly rolled, wrinkled sleeves, a small tied cravat, and a fitted black waistcoat with buttons, giving him a refined professor or alchemist look. Place him beside a dark chalkboard covered with glowing handwritten cursive formulas, equations, symbols, and sketch marks, but keep the writing decorative and mostly unreadable. Add wooden bookshelves and antique objects on the left side, including exactly 3 visible brass or gold-toned instruments/ornaments and a row of old books near the bottom. Use dramatic golden sunset light streaming from the upper left, strong rim lighting on his hair and sleeves, warm amber reflections, deep shadows, and atmospheric dust motes. Render with polished high-detail anime painting, cinematic composition, rich linework, glossy eyes, soft bloom, warm environmental color grading, and elegant romantic academia mood. Keep the background detailed but secondary, avoid modern items, avoid extra characters, and do not include readable text or watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张 2:3 竖版动漫风格肖像插画，描绘一位在温暖复古书房中的魅力年轻男学者。主体是一位身材修长、英俊的年轻人，拥有 深赤红色 的中长波浪发，长刘海遮住一只眼睛，有着锐利的 翠绿色 双眼、白皙的皮肤和一丝自信的微笑。他以四分之三侧身姿势站立，直视观众，一只手若有所思地轻触嘴唇，另一只手臂横在胸前，怀抱一本合上的深色书籍。为他穿上一件挺括的米色衬衫，袖口微卷且带有褶皱，系着一条小领结，外搭一件修身黑色马甲，展现出精致的教授或炼金术士形象。将他置于一块写满发光手写草书公式、方程式、符号和草图标记的深色黑板旁，但保持文字为装饰性且不可辨认。在左侧添加木质书架和古董物件，包括 3 个清晰可见的黄铜或金色调仪器/装饰品，底部摆放一排旧书。使用从左上方倾泻而下的戏剧性金色日落光，头发和袖口处有强烈的轮廓光，伴随温暖的琥珀色反射、深邃的阴影和空气中的尘埃微粒。以精致的高细节动漫绘画风格渲染，采用电影级构图，线条丰富，双眼明亮，带有柔光效果，环境色彩温暖，营造出优雅的浪漫学院氛围。背景需保持细节但作为次要元素，避免出现现代物品，避免增加额外角色，且不要包含可读文字或水印。
